paragraphs.text: The Teratogens constitute a class of the Golgari elite on Ravnica ; the other classes being the Devkarin and the humans. Up until the Decamillennial , the teratogens were the ruling class. Afterward, however, the Devkarin took over.
Teratogens can essentially come from any background conceivable, though they consist primarily of non-humanoids such as plants , mutants , harpies , nagas , griffins , and centaurs .
